scope: 29 automatic endpoint-derived routes whose source and target are both draggable wall devices
decision: Keep the rectilinear visibility-graph solver as the production router. The 30 mm voxel A* result is 1.80 m shorter and 61 mm shallower, but adds 78 visible turns; the 40 mm realtime result is faster but is longer and adds 81 turns. Runtime is frontend-feasible, but uniform-grid endpoint adapters and sequential route order reduce visual quality. Retain voxel A* as an experimental collision-routing reference; an adaptive grid that includes exact port coordinates would be the next useful hybrid test.
